candidates.summary: Kuenzli Pond is open to fishing on a single day per year: the first Saturday in May (a Yerington Lions Club youth derby), and is closed the rest of the year as it is used for hatchery water settling.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Kuenzli Pond, Hatchery Outpond 1, 2 and 3

parameters.counting_rule: Daily limit is 3 game fish of which not more than 1 may be black bass. Possession limit is 6 game fish of which not more than 2 may be black bass.

candidates.summary: Daily limit 3 game fish (max 1 black bass); possession limit 6 game fish (max 2 black bass).

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Kuenzli Pond, Hatchery Outpond 1, 2 and 3

parameters.note: 8 AM to sunset on the single open day.

candidates.summary: Fishing is allowed from 8 AM to sunset on the open day.

parameters.note: Standard Nevada resident/nonresident fishing license required for anglers 12 and older.

candidates.summary: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers age 12 and older; no license required under age 12.

schedule.note: NDOW: the ponds are stocked with Rainbow Trout prior to May each year, ahead of the one-day season on the first Saturday in May. Stocking figures are reported for the Mason Valley Hatchery Outponds collectively, which include Kuenzli Pond.
